changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql:
-- SET NULL rather than CASCADE: a queue entry disappearing must not -- delete the court it was playing on. ALTER TABLE event_courts ADD CONSTRAINT fk_event_courts_team1_queue FOREIGN KEY (team1_queue_id) REFERENCES event_queue(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
ALTER TABLE event_courts ADD CONSTRAINT fk_event_courts_team2_queue FOREIGN KEY (team2_queue_id) REFERENCES event_queue(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE event_courts DROP CONSTRAINT fk_event_courts_team2_queue; ALTER TABLE event_courts DROP CONSTRAINT fk_event_courts_team1_queue;

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE events DROP CONSTRAINT ck_events_match_format;

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql:
-- The court board reads every court for one event, in order. CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_courts_event ON event_courts (event_id, court_number);
-- The LIVE label asks "is anything playing here right now" on every -- poll, so it is the hottest read in the phase. CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_courts_playing ON event_courts (event_id) WHERE status = 'playing';
changeSet.rollback: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_event_courts_playing; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_event_courts_event;

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE event_courts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
-- Anyone who can see the event can see its courts. A live score is -- the spectator feature this whole phase exists for, so reads are -- as open as the event itself - which is what fn_is_event_registered -- and the public/non-draft rule already express for registrations. -- -- No INSERT/UPDATE policy at all: every write goes through the -- service-role client from an endpoint that has already checked the -- caller is the organiser or club staff. Scores are the one thing -- players must not be able to write directly. CREATE POLICY event_courts_select ON event_courts FOR SELECT USING ( event_id IN ( SELECT id FROM events WHERE visibility = 'public' AND status != 'draft' ) OR fn_is_event_registered(event_id) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS event_courts_select ON event_courts; ALTER TABLE event_courts DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
